requirement: Every engine call of an import is paced from the first one, including cached-handover recovery; the pasted-token webroot probe sends the site's Basic credential only to the origin the customer gave; and a pasted Joomla token met by a Basic challenge asks for the extra password

oracle.ref: PR #1488 (fix); fix evidence: Before the fix the pacing link was created after the door search, so the first engine calls went out back to back and the cached-handover recovery was never paced; the pasted-token webroot probe sent no Basic credential; and a pasted token on a site whose admin asks for a Basic password was told the extension was not answering.
oracle.invariant: Exit code 0 and `# fail 0`. Pacing: the first two engine calls of a run (info, door probes) are at least the pacing interval apart, and the cached-handover recovery's engine calls are paced too. Basic on the webroot probe: a pasted Joomla token sends the Authorization header to the given origin; a redirect to another origin (apex to www, http to https) carries no Authorization; a same-origin redirect keeps it. Basic challenge: a pasted Joomla token whose admin door answers 401 with a Basic challenge, no engine door answering, is basic_auth_required with check basic_challenge; with no answer at all it stays cowork_not_answering.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: the first engine calls of a run share the site link pacing
an apex that 301s to www resolves to www
a same-origin redirect keeps the caller credential
an https webRootUrl retry recovers over https and corrects the handed-over address
a pasted Joomla token sends Basic auth on the webroot probe
a pasted Joomla token with an unanswered Basic challenge asks for the extra password
without it, a Basic challenge asks for the extra password
no answer at all, asked twice, is cowork_not_answering with check network
